name: janus-observatory
description: An interactive, evidence-backed atlas of possible technological civilizations.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @janus/domain typecheck && pnpm --filter @janus/agent typecheck && pnpm --filter @janus/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @janus/domain typecheck && pnpm --filter @janus/agent typecheck && pnpm --filter @janus/web typecheck
scripts.test:python: uv run --project pipeline --extra dev pytest pipeline/tests
scripts.lint:python: uv run --project pipeline --extra dev ruff check pipeline
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm lint:python && pnpm test:python && pnpm source:validate && pnpm build
